name: copilot
description: GitHub Copilot CLI. No global skills directory: the bundle installs to ~/.copilot/skills and is attached to a session via /add-dir. Experimental - flag surface not yet verified against the copilot binary.

install.headless: copilot --allow-tool 'write' --allow-tool 'shell(mkdir:*)' -p 'Read ~/.copilot/skills/vulnhunt/SKILL.md and execute the /vulnhunt workflow on this repository (read-only mode)'   # verify flags with `copilot -h` on your install
install.notes: Experimental: Copilot CLI was not available for local verification. Confirm the non-interactive prompt flag and permission flag names (`copilot help permissions`) before scripting.
